# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Bard level 2 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline to level 2 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat/performance posture from the
# level-1 fixture, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no performance-state
# engine (start/maintain action economy, round tracking/consumption), no
# Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile Performance execution (the PF1 Core
# Rulebook 2nd-level Bard class feature substituting a chosen Perform skill
# for its associated skills — a choice-gated substitution engine this bounded
# seam deliberately does not ground), and no spontaneous known-spell / slot
# posture burden.

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:2
